1.1 Achieved. The Roadmap for obtaining accreditation in GANHRI is developed and submitted to the Office of Ombudsperson via diplomatic channels. 1.3 Achieved. Recommendations on making amendments and additions to the legislation of Turkmenistan to strengthen the institutions of the Ombudsperson’s Office was developed by APF experts and national expert and submitted to the office of Ombudsperson to be further submitted to the Parliament of Turkmenistan. 1.4. Achieved. Capacity of the staff of the Ombudsperson’s Office to monitor and evaluate the performance of national human rights institutions increased as a result of activities delivered with involvement of national and international experts.(40%). Moreover, the Ombudsperson`s office first time participated at the Annual General meeting of APF and other regional conferences. 1.5. Achieved. The capacity of the staff of the Ombudsperson’s Office in the area of complaint mechanisms in line with the Paris Principles increased. (100%) 2.1. Achieved. 60 representatives of law enforcement agencies, judges and lawyers who are aware of international norms and standards in the field of human rights and the activities of the Ombudsperson’s Office. 3.1. Achieved. 100 civil servants, representatives of law-enforcement agencies, ministries, public organizations from velayats and Ashgabat city participated in the seminar on the Role of Ombudsperson`s on Ensuring Rights of Women in Turkmenistan. 3.2. Achieved. Development and publication of the Brochure on the Work of Ombudsperson. (1000 copies)

1.2. Achieved. Capacity Assessment mission composed of representatives of APF experts and UNDP and OHCHR regional representatives conducted the Capacity Assessment of the Ombudsperson`s Office in Turkmenistan under the Tripartite Partnership Agreement. As a result of it, Report with thorough recommendations and Strategic plan for the Ombudspersons office in Turkmenistan was delivered. 1.3. Achieved. The workshop “Improving Grievance Handling Mechanism in Compliance with Paris Principles” with involvement of international expert George Tugushi was was delivered. As a result of the workshop, the international expert developed Recommendations for the Ombudsperson`s Office along with the Draft of the Regulation of Ombudsperson`s office on procedure of handling grievances of citizens in compliance with Paris Principles. 1.4. Achieved. As a result of the delivered Capacity Assessment of the Ombudsperson`s office (Five step process) the national human rights institution`s - Ombudsperson`s Office`s capacity to conduct its work in Turkmenistan based on Paris Principles was conducted. This assessment mission and its thorough report will ensure to increase the capacity of the Ombudsperson`s Office and plan its future work based on the provided recommendation and Strategic plan in the future years. 2.1. Achieved with more than targeted amount of representatives. Workshops (details described in the annual report) in hybrid format were convened on the cooperation of national human rights institutions with the Ombudsperson`s Office with law-enforcement agencies and promotion of full implementation of human rights in the country. The event gathered representatives of the Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Prosecutor`s Office, Judicial system, other ministries, and agencies including civil society organizations from Akhal, Mary, Balkan, Dashoguz, Lebap velayats, and Ashgabat city. The event gathered representatives of the judicial system, Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Prosecutor`s Office, other law enforcement agencies and Bar Associations from Akhal, Mary, Balkan, Dashoguz, Lebap velayats, and Ashgabat city. (List of pax is attached to QA and annual report). 3.1. Achieved with more than targeted amount of representatives. Workshops (details described in the annual report) in hybrid format were convened on the activities of national human rights institutions in the preparation of reports on human rights, and promotion of full implementation of human rights in the country. The event gathered representatives of the Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Prosecutor`s Office, Judicial system, other ministries, and agencies including civil society organizations from Akhal, Mary, Balkan, Dashoguz, Lebap velayats, and Ashgabat city. The event gathered representatives of the judicial system, Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Prosecutor`s Office, other law enforcement agencies and Bar Associations from Akhal, Mary, Balkan, Dashoguz, Lebap velayats, and Ashgabat city. (List of pax is attached to QA and annual report). 3.2. Achieved. For the workshops delivered in the result 2.1. the project developed Collection of regulations for the law-enforcement agencies, judiciary system and bar associations to ensure the compliance of human rights in their daily work. The Collection was printed in 100 copies also the electronic version of the Collection was sent to representatives of above mentioned entities in all five velayats/regions of the country.
